title: Cost Estimator
subtitle: LLM usage costs, budgets, and forecasts
serverSubtitle: What this project's agents spent on the server over the last 30 days

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Read before every agent session of a task, whatever the provider: thresholds noted in the task's log, a pause at the limit, an optional lighter model.
budget.noProjectLimit: No project budget: only the per-task limit applies.
budget.spentFloor: at least {{amount}} spent (a model with no known price)

alert.warning: {{spent}} spent of {{limit}}. At the limit, running tasks are {{action}}.
alert.critical: {{spent}} spent of {{limit}}, the limit is close. At the limit, running tasks are {{action}}.

form.usdHint: Amounts in US dollars, like the providers' prices. Empty or 0: no limit.
form.degrade: Switch to a lighter model as the budget runs out
form.degradeHint: At the warning threshold, a flagship model moves to the same provider's standard tier; at the critical one, to its fast tier.
form.stall: Pause a task that spends without making progress
form.stallHint: A task that spends three times the average cost of its completed subtasks without completing another one is paused.
form.saveFailed: The budget could not be saved

emptyBody: Costs appear here once a task has called a model for this project.
